subject: Thomas Frank named Palace manager on a three-year deal, with Spurs coffee-cup saga in tow
title: Frank's new job, same coffee cup

lines.vo: Palace's new boss has a three-year deal and a coffee problem.
lines.footage: Thomas Frank Crystal Palace appointed announcement

lines.vo: Thomas Frank's contract runs to June twenty twenty-nine. Palace sit bottom, and he starts away at Coventry.
lines.footage: Crystal Palace Premier League table, Coventry highlights

lines.vo: In January, as Spurs boss, he was photographed with an Arsenal cup.
He had said drinking a rival's cup on purpose would be absolutely stupid.
Spurs sacked him in February, after under eight months. Some cups last longer.
Now he hopes not to be pictured with another rival's cup. Plain bottle at Coventry, then.
lines.footage: Thomas Frank Crystal Palace press conference, Coventry City stadium

lines.vo: Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: Setup: a cartoon Frank poses for a photo holding a mug with a tiny red-and-white flag. Gag: the mug shrieks like a kettle and the flag pops up like a periscope. Twist: he hides it in his coat, and a hundred identical mugs march out of the other sleeve.
inserts.characters: Generic cartoon photographer; caricature of Thomas Frank

inserts.story: Setup: a cartoon Frank gets a stopwatch from a cartoon club director: 'Under eight months.' Gag: the stopwatch hits zero and a mug-shaped alarm clock explodes in his face. Twist: the steam clears and he is wearing a tiny cardboard crown that says 'Cup holder'.
inserts.characters: Generic cartoon club director; caricature of Thomas Frank

inserts.story: Setup: a cartoon Frank walks into a press room with a very plain water bottle, held up like a trophy. Gag: every cartoon reporter leans in and squints at the label. Twist: the label reads 'Not a cup', and the bottle grows a handle.
inserts.characters: Generic cartoon reporters; caricature of Thomas Frank

facts_used: Palace appointed Thomas Frank on a three-year contract to June 2029 after sacking Pierre Sage (ev0002)
Palace are bottom of the Premier League; his first game is away at Coventry on Saturday 21 November (ev0002)
In January, as Spurs manager, Frank was photographed with an Arsenal-branded cup before a loss to Bournemouth; he said drinking a rival's cup deliberately would be absolutely stupid (ev0002)
Spurs sacked Frank in February after under eight months (ev0002 background)
Frank says he hopes not to be pictured with another rival's cup (ev0002)
notes: Comic, 3 inserts (zero-based after_line), EL 600-char limit. Jokes only on the cup photo and the sacking timeline. 'Some cups last longer' is a joke on the 'under eight months' fact, no claim beyond it. Insert characters are generic cartoons and a caricature, no franchise characters, no logos. Data note: ESPN and Palace release used; Frank's age and personal matters are not used.
